title: yesterday i generated a room from an image, today i did the same with a character image :) (roughly 3 minutes generation time)
author: Curious_Writing1682

comments.author: Spiritual-Bus-9903
comments.body: What's this tool name or are you running it locally?

replies.author: Curious_Writing1682
replies.body: using 3daistudio but you could run hunyuan locally if you have a good GPU with comfy!

comments.author: mizerr
comments.body: Yes but 1 mill vertices, thats the issue with all the current 3d gens. Very impressive for sure, but not game ready yet realistically.

replies.author: codeninja
replies.body: It's only a matter of time before the right algorithms come along and make that trivial.

replies.author: Marceloo25
replies.body: When that happens, I'll be here to use it but until then, gotta make them by hand if you want to use it on a game

replies.author: isrichards6
replies.body: Still could be useful if you did a dead cells approach and prerendered the art though right?

replies.author: mizerr
replies.body: I'm not sure what you mean by this with the dead cells approach?

replies.author: isrichards6
replies.body: Essentially they made 3d models and then used a pixelator add on and rendered the art for the game. So its "2d" but actually made with 3d. At that point bad topology doesn't matter.

replies.author: spacespacespapce
replies.body: Curious what you think about NativeBlend: https://nativeblend.app

replies.author: mizerr
replies.body: It's an interesting approach, going from ground up building in blender. I would think that's expensive? I see most attempts going the opposite way starting with a very high poly version and attempting to decimate it down and rebake textures, but that has a ways to go too.

replies.author: spacespacespapce
replies.body:
Ya it's more expensive from this approach, but with LLMs getting cheaper it's already gotten lower in price in a few months. 


It's about $0.1 to make a model rn, and about $0.16 to make it on Meshy (with credits)

replies.author: speederaser
replies.body: I mean decimating is just one button right? I don't see how this is a problem.

replies.author: mizerr
replies.body: That'd be the dream if it was so simple.

replies.author: stun_l0ck
replies.body: Last I checked hunyuan 2.5 outputted 500k verts. Still massive, but I've played around with getting that down to 10k with quadroflow and decimate. It did make it more ps2 looking but I really dug it!

replies.author: mizerr
replies.body: 3.0 can now do 50k, you should give it a try!

replies.author: stun_l0ck
replies.body: Woah, yeah for sure I will! Literal game changer lol thank you for letting me know :D
